<context path="tools/tests/fixtures" updated="2026-10-22">

Small, deterministic input files for the BrightScript parser suite. Each file exercises one catalog shape or one set of edge cases.

## Summary

- `busca.txt` — Search index with movies, series, an anime, accents, duplicates, and a restricted title.
- `catalogo.txt` — Custom channel list with source metadata, multiple sources, a ClearKey entry, and an empty channel.
- `destaques.txt` — Discover shelves with mixed movie, series, dorama, anime, and restricted entries.
- `fichas.txt` — Artwork and genre rows for movies and series, including relative and absolute poster URLs.
- `filmes-A.txt` — Movie fragment with dubbed and subtitled sources, a duplicate, a dead URL, a restricted title, and a title without a source.
- `indice.txt` — Letter counts, numbered video bases, and the `#` letter.
- `series-A-0.txt` — Episode fragment for multiple series, with duplicate and base-expanded sources.
- `series-A.txt` — Series fragment with pieces, episode counts, duplicates, accents, and a restricted title.
- `vod.m3u` — M3U VOD list with one film, a grouped series with two episodes, and a restricted entry.

## Constraints

- MUST keep the exact rows and counts expected by `tools/tests/parsers_test.brs`; the tests assert specific titles, sources, and totals.
- MUST keep fixtures as local text; the parser suite does not use the network.

## Guidance

- SHOULD add a new fixture instead of overloading an existing one when the behavior is unrelated.
- SHOULD update the test and fixture in the same change.
